eyebrow: An open-source WLED installer, forged by free folk
welcome: Hark, brave adventurer! Welcome to the WLED web installer!
uiModeHint: The Novice’s Path keeps thy journey simple: choose a version and install at 4MB. Walk the Hero’s Path for flash size, memory type, flash mode, and HUB75 layout trials.
unsupported1: Alas! Thy browser is not yet worthy of this quest!
unsupported2: Seek thee Chrome or Edge upon a desktop realm.
loadError1: The scrolls of WLED versions could not be fetched from the GitHub archives.
loadError2: Check thy connection and reload this page, or claim a binary relic by hand:
proxyBlocked1: The firmware trade route is blocked for this connection.
proxyBlocked2: This installer fetches firmware through download.wled.me, WLED’s own official CORS-blessed waystation - some force in this network or browser (an ad-blocker, a firewall, or a DNS warden) bars the way, so installing now would curse thy device with corrupted data.
proxyBlocked3: Try banishing any ad-blocker or VPN from this page, or consult thy network’s firewall decrees.
proxyBlocked4: Thou mayest still claim a binary relic by hand:
checkingProxy: Scouting the firmware trade route for passage…
step1-1: Plug thy ESP into a USB port, brave one. We shall bestow upon it WLED
step2: Strike “Begin Thy Quest” and choose the true COM port.
noDeviceFound: No device found upon the road?
serialHelp1: Thou mayest be missing the drivers for thy board.
serialHelp2: Herein lie drivers for chips oft found in ESP boards:
serialHelp3: Ensure thy USB cable can bear the weight of data, not merely power.
step3: Complete thy quest: WLED installed and bound in under 3 minutes!
flashSizeHint: Choose the flash size matching thy board - consult the chart above to learn which chip clans wield which size.
layoutHint: Choose the board matching thy HUB75 formation - consult the chart above for the chip and flash size it demands.
memoryTypeHint: Matters only if thy board bears PSRAM - choose the rite matching its interface. Leave upon Standard if unsure, or if thy board bears none.
flashModeHint: Default matches the flash mode this release’s standard build already wields for each chip - the safest rite, and required to match an existing bootloader when updating in place. DIO/QIO force that mode where a matching release build exists - consult the chart above for which chip(s) this currently applies to.
